round4_lesson_extraction.intro:
You can see your Stage-3 verdict above and your full reasoning. Below is the ground-truth — the correct answer.
Reflect on why your earlier decision diverged. What observation, signal, or reasoning step did you miss or get wrong? Then suggest a transferable rule your future self should apply on similar episodes so this mistake doesn't repeat.
Focus on the BIGGEST gap first. Priority: **verdict** (success/failure) > **onset** > **type**. If verdict itself is wrong, write a rule about **failure detection**, not type labeling — a type rule cannot fix a verdict miss because you never reach the type-classification step.
round4_lesson_extraction.your_task:
Write a brief introspection (1-2 sentences on what specifically you missed) — then your suggestion in ONE of these formats:
```lesson ADD: ```
or
```lesson UPDATE : ```
or
```lesson MERGE [, ]: ```
or
```lesson NONE ```
(NONE if no transferable rule applies, or buffer already covers it.)
Avoid: task names / episode IDs / specific seconds; rules that just restate a taxonomy name in different words.
